functions.name: and
functions.documentation: Returns true if and only if both arguments are true. Returns false if one of the arguments is true and the other argument is false or if both arguments are false.

functions.name: boolean
functions.documentation: Returns true if the <str> has literal value "true".

functions.name: boolean-equal
functions.documentation: Returns true if both arguments are true or if both arguments are false. Returns false if one of the arguments is true and the other argument is false.

functions.name: boolean-not-equal
functions.documentation: Returns true if one of the arguments is true and the other argument is false.

functions.name: not
functions.documentation: Returns the logical negation of the argument (true if the boolean value is false, and false if the boolean value is true).

functions.name: or
functions.documentation: Returns true if one or both of the arguments arguments are true. Returns false if both arguments are false.

Based on the returned Boolean value, the function returns an xsd:dateTime representing the value received after the evaluation of either the second or the third input parameter.

functions.name: add-dayTimeDuration-to-dateTime
functions.documentation:
Returns the xs:dateTime computed by adding <duration> to the value of <value>.
If <duration> is negative, then the result xs:dateTime precedes <value>.
The result has the same timezone as <value>.
If <value> has no timezone, the result has no timezone.

functions.name: add-yearMonthDuration-to-dateTime
functions.documentation:
Returns the xs:dateTime computed by adding <ymDiration> to the value of <value>.
If <ymDiration> is negative, then the result xs:dateTime precedes <value>.
The result has the same timezone as <value>.
If <value> has no timezone, the result has no timezone.

functions.name: current-dateTime
functions.documentation: Returns the current dateTime.

functions.name: dateTime-equal
functions.documentation: Returns true if and only if the value of left is equal to the value of right. Returns false otherwise.

functions.name: dateTime-greater-equal
functions.documentation: Returns true if and only if left is greater than or equal right. Returns false otherwise.

functions.name: dateTime-greater-than
functions.documentation: Returns true if and only if the value of <left> is greater than the value of <right>

functions.name: dateTime-less-equal
functions.documentation: Returns true if and only if <left> is less than or equal <right>. Returns false otherwise

functions.name: dateTime-less-than
functions.documentation: Returns true if and only if the value of <left> is less than the value of <right>.

functions.name: dateTime-not-equal
functions.documentation: Returns true if and only if the value of left is not equal to the value of right. Returns false otherwise.

functions.name: day-from-dateTime
functions.documentation: Returns an xs:int between 1 and 31, both inclusive, representing the day component in the localized value of <value>

functions.name: hours-from-dateTime
functions.documentation: Returns an xs:int between 0 and 23, both inclusive, representing the hours component in the localized value of <value>.

functions.name: minutes-from-dateTime
functions.documentation: Returns an xs:int value between 0 and 59, both inclusive, representing the minute component in the localized value of <value>.

functions.name: month-from-dateTime
functions.documentation: Returns an xs:int between 1 and 12, both inclusive, representing the month component in the localized value of <value>.

functions.name: seconds-from-dateTime
functions.documentation: Returns an xs:int value greater than or equal to zero and less than 60, representing the seconds in the localized value of <value>.

functions.name: subtract-dateTimes
functions.documentation:
Returns the xs:dayTimeDuration that corresponds to the difference between the normalized value of <left> and the normalized value of <right>.
if the normalized value of <left> precedes in time the normalized value of <right>, then the returned value is a negative duration.

functions.name: subtract-dayTimeDuration-from-dateTime
functions.documentation:
Returns the xs:dateTime computed by negating <duration> and adding the result to the value of <value>.
If <duration> is negative, then the xs:dateTime returned follows <value>.
The result has the same timezone as <value>. 
If <value> has no timezone, the result has no timezone.

functions.name: subtract-yearMonthDuration-from-dateTime
functions.documentation:
Returns the xs:dateTime computed by negating <duration> and adding the result to the value of <value>.
If <duration> is negative, then the xs:dateTime returned follows <value>.
The result has the same timezone as <value>.
If <value> has no timezone, the result has no timezone.

functions.name: year-from-dateTime
functions.documentation:
Returns an xs:int representing the year component in the localized value of <value>. 
			The result may be negative.
